description: Exhaustive binding from every hardware-layer package to the board SKU whose firmware it holds, or to null when it holds none. This is the single declaration of which package IS which board; config/config-string-contract.json derives every config string's board composition from it by walking the ESPHome include graph. Exhaustiveness is enforced by tests/test_config_string_contract.py: every YAML under the listed directories must appear exactly once, and no entry may name a file that does not exist, so a new package cannot enter the tree unclassified. PR 07 removed sixteen hardware-layer paths (twelve expansion aliases, the power_poe and led_ring_ceiling aliases, and both halves of the undocumented led-mic pair) after re-pointing every live consumer to the authoritative board package; the exhaustiveness test enforced this file moving in the same commit.

rules.a_binding_is_not_hardware_evidence: A binding records which board a package's firmware implements. It never upgrades that board's schematic_status, never claims a sensor is fitted, and never claims a connector-attached attachment is supplied.
rules.aliases_bind_to_null: An alias contributes no SKU of its own. Removing an alias in PR 07 must therefore leave every resolved composition byte-identical.
rules.null_is_a_decision_not_a_gap: board_sku null is an explicit classification with a recorded reason, never an omission.
rules.board_sku_must_exist_upstream: Every non-null board_sku must be a real SKU in config/hardware-catalog.json. This file never mints a board identity.

bases.authoritative-board-firmware: This file holds the board's own firmware content, so it contributes the SKU.
bases.alias: A legacy or naming alias. The SKU is contributed by whatever the alias resolves to, so the resolved composition is unchanged when the alias is removed.
bases.composer: Composes other packages and holds no board content of its own.
bases.connector-attached-sensor-driver: A driver for a connector-attached sensor option. The host board contributes the SKU; binding the driver would assert an inclusion the hardware catalogue does not declare.
bases.legacy-pre-r4-driver: A pre-R4 legacy driver whose sensor set matches no R4 board SKU.
bases.not-board-bearing: Shared or superseded infrastructure that implements no board.

bindings.reason: Authoritative S360-100 ceiling Core board firmware. PR 07 Core source-of-truth flip: the content moved here verbatim from the deleted packages/hardware/sense360_core_ceiling.yaml; the former overlay declared nothing of its own, so every resolved configuration is unchanged.
Authoritative RoomIQ climate half: LTR-303ALS ambient light and SHT4x temperature/humidity.
Authoritative RoomIQ PCB-mounted PIR half (EKMC1601111).
Authoritative RoomIQ radar half. Binds the connector-attached LD2450 to the RoomIQ board; the SKU is the host board, never a claim that the radar is supplied (OD-SOT-004 stays open).
Authoritative RoomIQ SEN0609/C4001 half. Same host-board-only reading as the LD2450 half.
Authoritative RoomIQ board UART binding for the Hi-Link radar connector.
Composes the three authoritative ceiling RoomIQ halves; holds no driver content of its own.
AirIQ S3-lineage overlay; adds board-specific bus deltas on top of the canonical AirIQ board.
AirIQ SFA40 opt-out overlay. Retained while OD-SOT-008 (SFA40 fitment) is open; the overlay decides nothing about fitment either way.
AirIQ opt-in SPS30 overlay for the external particulate module. Opting in composes the attachment; it never makes the module supplied.
Authoritative AirIQ board firmware.
Authoritative VentIQ board firmware.
Authoritative LED board firmware (WS2812B ceiling halo).
Authoritative PoE PSU board firmware.
GP8403 0-10V analog fan driver firmware for the Sense360 DAC board. No packages/boards entry exists for S360-312; the board is schematic_status cataloged_unverified.

SX1509-lineage FanPWM composition: composes the neutral fan_pwm_sx1509.yaml binding layer AND declares the four customer fan speed controllers, so it is NOT a thin alias. Kept with reason: the preserved legacy compile-only skeleton products/compile-only/ceiling-poe-fanpwm.yaml (historical SX1509 compile proof) composes it. PR 07 initially misclassified it as an alias and the deletion was reverted before commit; the native fan_pwm_native.yaml path remains the current S360-311 implementation.
Native-GPIO PWM fan driver firmware, the current S360-311 implementation.
SX1509-expander PWM fan driver firmware; superseded by the native path but still composed.
Relay fan driver firmware for the Sense360 Relay board. No packages/boards entry exists for S360-310; the board is schematic_status cataloged_unverified.
TRIAC phase-dimmer firmware for the Sense360 TRIAC board. Experimental / advanced-manual lane only; no electrical-safety, EMC or compliance claim is made or implied.
Legacy / superseded SX1509 expander path (SX1509-RECONCILE-001). Retained with reason for the CORE-ABSTRACT-BUS-001C interrupt-pin guard; implements no board.
LD2412 radar driver for a connector-attached option; host-board-only reading.
Standalone PWM fan-driver composition consumed by the published legacy product products/sense360-fan-pwm.yaml.
Authoritative 240V mains PSU firmware. No packages/boards entry exists for S360-400; the board is schematic_status cataloged_unverified and the PWR power token is compliance-blocked.
USB-C input configuration on the Core itself. There is no USB PSU board SKU: USB power is a Core input, not a separate module.
LD2412 radar driver for a connector-attached option; same host-board-only reading.
Core board firmware, legacy functional path still holding content.

Pre-R4 S3-lineage Core firmware, kept with reason: read directly by the CORE-ABSTRACT-BUS-001 guards in tests/test_core_abstract_bus.py as the S3 out-of-scope reference, paired with the retained s360-210-airiq-ceiling-s3 board. The S3 lineage retires wholesale with PR 08.
Core connector pin map.
Core PoE-variant firmware. The PSU board itself is S360-410 and is composed separately.
Core voice-variant firmware; consumed by the published legacy product products/sense360-fan-pwm.yaml.

capability_board_map.description: Which board each config/core-framework.json capability token requires. This is the canonical link between the declared capability set and the resolved board composition; tests/test_config_string_contract.py asserts the two agree for every configuration. A capability is a compile-time composition fact, never a runtime health or hardware claim.

notes.power_usb: USB-C is a Core input, not a separate PSU board: there is no USB PSU SKU, so the capability maps to no board.
notes.presence: Presence is delivered by the connector-attached radars on the S360-200 RoomIQ board. The map names the host board only; OD-SOT-004 (radar evidence) stays open and nothing here decides it.
